parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: $E(X)=[1(15)+2(10)+3(6)+4(3)+5(1)]/35=70/35=2$. M1: at least four correct terms, FT their (a), with probabilities summing to 1; may be implied by variance, unsimplified accepted. $\operatorname{Var}(X)=[1^2(15)+2^2(10)+3^2(6)+4^2(3)+5^2(1)]/35-2^2=182/35-4=6/5$. M1: appropriate variance formula using their $[E(X)]^2$, FT their table even if probabilities do not sum to 1. A1: $6/5$. If following incorrect (b), unsimplified $E(X)$ and variance expressions must be shown with all probabilities below 1. Total: 3.
